answer: Each identity locks 60 credits to open a challenge chain at a summit. Each epoch demands a new link: climb the next summit, file a quill-signed answer. A prism auditor checks the chain; a reused or rented link breaks it and burns the bond. Fake k: 40+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes: 2,537,500, plus 60,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-chain ring fails on the prism ledger: each quill signature binds one summit to one agent. Honest pay 40 once.
